gloss: to abandon; to renounce; to give up

definitions.gloss: to abandon; to give up; to relinquish
definitions.explanation: To voluntarily cease holding onto or pursuing something, such as a right, plan, or possession.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放棄|ほうき}する。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{放棄|ほうき}した。
examples.english: He abandoned the match midway through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放棄|ほうき}するわけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいかない。
examples.english: I can't just abandon my responsibilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The procedure for renouncing an inheritance is done at family court.

notes:
A formal word for giving up or relinquishing something deliberately. Often used in legal and official contexts. The noun ⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧ is frequently used in compound forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放棄|ほうき}する: to waive a right
- ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧: abandonment of responsibility
- ⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧: renunciation of inheritance
- ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧: forfeiting a match
- ⟦{核|かく}→核：13127_kaku⟧⟦{放棄|ほうき}→放棄：12825_houki⟧: nuclear disarmament

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧: to give up — more emotional and personal; implies accepting defeat
- ⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to throw away — more concrete; implies discarding something
- ⟦{断念|だんねん}する→断念する：20717_dannensuru⟧: to abandon (a plan) — focuses on reluctantly giving up an ambition or plan
